chunks: That is because they opposed God and His Apostle; and whoever opposes God and His Apostle (should know) that God is severe in retribution.
ai.seo_question: Why did God punish those who opposed Him and His Apostle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific context of the Banu Qurayza or the broader concept of *shiqqa* (disobedience) against the divine authority established through the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores the severity of opposing God's will as manifested in His Messenger, serving as a warning that such opposition incurs Allah's severe punishment (*shadid al-iqab*), a principle central to understanding divine justice in both this world and the Hereafter.
